document.about: PMC5847320, PLOS ONE 2018, word embeddings learnt with a knowledge base. Its line plots stand each over its caption (`Fig 1. Effect of the corpus size. …`), the caption wider than the plot and set under the axis's values and name. The PDF is linked from the PMC article page; PMC refuses scripted downloads.

notes: 2026-11-28 (#634): TeX's Computer Modern fonts embedded under a generic vector, the ASCII names at their codes, are read by TeX's layout for each family (OT1, OML, OMS, OMX).

checks.issue: `R(wi, wj)(wi − w̃j)2` read `R(wi; wj)(wi w̃j)2`: the math italic's comma read `;` and the symbols font's minus as nothing. This document has no ToUnicode maps, so the glyph names are read, and they are the codes' ASCII names too.
`λ ∈ R+` read `λ 2 R+`: the symbols font's ∈, code 50, read as its code's name, `two`.
